coverage.summary: CRITICAL COVERAGE GAP - Only 4 functional tests for 63 controllers

critical_findings.issue: 59 out of 63 controllers lack functional tests
critical_findings.impact: High - Payment, order, and admin operations untested

critical_findings.issue: Tests exist only for: VendorApiController, ConversationController, WishlistApiController, TestApiController
critical_findings.recommendation: Create functional tests for all API endpoints, especially: Checkout (payment), CustomerOrder (finance), Admin operations

security.summary: MODERATE RISK - Good framework defaults, but gaps in authorization checks

critical_issues.title: Missing Authorization Checks
critical_issues.description: Only 7 controllers use #[IsGranted] attribute. Many endpoints lack authorization.
unprotected_endpoints: VendorApiController - Shop/Product CRUD needs VENDOR role verification
MeController - Update profile without IS_AUTHENTICATED check
critical_issues.recommendation: Add #[IsGranted] on all protected endpoints; implement authorization voters for vendor/shop ownership

critical_issues.title: EmailVerificationController - No Rate Limiting
critical_issues.issue: Email verification endpoint accepts token without rate limiting. Vulnerable to brute force.
critical_issues.recommendation: Implement rate limiting on token verification endpoints

critical_issues.title: EntityManager Direct Usage
locations: Api/CheckoutController:132 - getRepository() instead of dependency injection
critical_issues.issue: Direct EntityManager usage bypasses repository patterns and transaction safety
critical_issues.risk: Inconsistent data handling, potential data integrity issues

critical_issues.title: CORS Configuration Overly Permissive
critical_issues.issue: allow_origin: ['*'] in defaults; only API paths have CORS_ALLOW_ORIGIN restriction
critical_issues.recommendation: Remove wildcard CORS default; explicitly list allowed origins

critical_issues.title: JWT Token Configuration
critical_issues.details: Token TTL configured via JWT_TOKEN_TTL env var, secret keys from env, passphrase set
critical_issues.note: Verify token_ttl value in .env (typically should be 3600-7200 seconds max)

critical_issues.title: CSRF Protection Configured
critical_issues.details: Stateless CSRF tokens for forms/logout; checked in CartController, WishlistController, VendorShippingController
critical_issues.note: Not uniformly applied - some controllers missing CSRF verification

vulnerabilities_not_found.sql_injection: ✓ No SQL concatenation detected - using QueryBuilder/Doctrine ORM
vulnerabilities_not_found.password_exposure: ✓ No hardcoded passwords or secrets in code

Handles form validation, normalization, file uploads - needs refactoring
Logo/banner upload logic could be extracted to service
Slug generation logic repeated - should be in service

code_duplications.issue: CSRF token validation duplicated across Web controllers

naming_consistency.pattern: Consistent camelCase for methods, snake_case for table/column names
naming_consistency.note: Controllers well-organized by namespace (Web, Api, Admin)

positive_patterns.note: ✓ Repositories use QueryBuilder with leftJoin/addSelect for eager loading

Shop slug generation, HTML sanitization, logo/banner uploads

conclusion: The TechNova platform has solid architecture foundations with clear service/repository patterns and proper database migrations. However, critical gaps exist in test coverage (only 6.4% of endpoints tested) and security enforcement (missing authorization checks on many endpoints). The codebase needs immediate attention to: (1) authorization enforcement, (2) test coverage expansion, and (3) controller refactoring to reduce complexity. Not recommended for production without addressing at least the CRITICAL and HIGH severity issues.
